import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        print(0)
        return
    
    n = int(data[0])
    if n == 0:
        print(0)
        return
    
    weights = list(map(int, data[1:1+n]))
    
    total_sum = sum(weights)
    target = total_sum / 2.0
    
    weights.sort()
    
    team1_sum = 0
    team1_count = 0
    
    for w in weights:
        if team1_sum <= target:
            team1_sum += w
            team1_count += 1
    
    team2_count = n - team1_count
    diff_players = abs(team1_count - team2_count)
    print(diff_players)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
